_doc: Cumulative trial count for the family-wise Deflated-Sharpe correction. Every diagnostic that computes deflated_sharpe_ratio MUST read cumulative_n_trials from here rather than passing a per-run or guessed value, otherwise DSR overstates significance. A 'trial' = one independent strategy configuration evaluated for a PROMOTE/KILL decision. Pure measurement diagnostics that make no trade decision are NOT trials.

_reset.rationale: The carried arm-level count of 138 had made the Deflated-Sharpe bar effectively unpassable: every trial ever run permanently raised the significance threshold for all future ones, including trials on retired books (the v1 14-day model, the momentum base) that do not bind the book now being researched. The owner elected a clean counter.
_reset.what_this_does_NOT_change: DSR deflation corrects for multiple testing ON A GIVEN DATASET. Resetting the counter adds no information. The binding constraint, measured 2026-08-07, is n_eff = 37 independent 63-day windows on 2017-2026 Indian daily equity data, giving a dSharpe confidence half-width of 0.59. No edge below roughly 0.6 Sharpe is resolvable on that data by any method at any trial count. The reset lowers a bar; it does not sharpen the instrument.
_reset.the_discipline_that_makes_the_reset_hone: A reset counter only means something if the next trials run on data the prior 138 never touched. The elected direction is intraday bars (2h / 15m) for the F&O universe -- genuinely new sample. Trials on the SAME 2017-2026 daily windows continue the old count in substance even though this file starts at zero; increment honestly and do not read the reset as a licence to re-run dead tests on the same data.

methodology: arm-level count of trade-bearing strategy configs evaluated for a PROMOTE/KILL decision (each multi-arm ablation contributes its arm count).
_increment_log: 2026-08-07: reset 138 -> 0 (see _reset). Increment BEFORE each run, never after. | 2026-08-07: 0 -> 1 — pre-reg 0001 cross-sectional momentum (NSE Normalized Momentum Score, MID band, top-30 equal-weight, monthly, buffer 1.5N). ONE trade-bearing configuration. Counted BEFORE the run per research/0001-xsec-momentum/prereg.md. The parameter neighbourhood swept alongside is for PBO only and adopts nothing, so it is not counted as additional trials. | 2026-08-07: 1 -> 2 — ENG-01 no-trade band (0.20 of target). INCREMENTED AFTER THE RUN, which breaks the before-the-run rule; recording the breach rather than hiding it. Cause: it was pre-classified as an 'engineering change, not a trial' on the reasoning that nothing was swept. That reasoning was wrong. Multiplicity comes from the OPTION TO ADOPT, not from how many values are tried — a single pre-derived configuration evaluated for adoption is exactly this file's definition of a trial, and had it passed it would have been adopted. One value tried, no retune after the miss, so the ordering did not affect the decision; the counter must still carry it.
